basic_info.description: This stunning Noe Valley Victorian has been transformed by Architect Jonathan Feldman into a wonderful 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath home. The main floor has an open plan with a formal dining room, living room with a gas fireplace, a large open eat-in kitchen and family room with a NanaWall of windows. The deck off of the kitchen features a fire pit. Elegant wainscoting compliments the rustic, wide planked, white oak floors. A contemporary steel and wood staircase leads to the bedroom level with a large master bedroom and bath, two more bedrooms, a full bath and laundry closet. The lowest level has a flexible 4th bedroom, family room, wine room, sauna and interior access to the large two-car garage.
